input: The system hangs after 'Booting Trusted OS' with no further output. JTAG shows CPU0 is stuck in EL3 executing a tight loop at the TrustZone world switch entry point. The Secure Monitor Call (SMC) from BL31 to the Trusted OS never returns. What are the common causes of a TrustZone world switch hang and how do I use JTAG/CoreSight to identify where the TEE is stuck?
